text: #742, step 3 of #566's plan and its last, recorded at #762's merge. Lifts D-0121's temporary restriction, and keeps D-0105, D-0301, D-0305, D-0311, D-0314, D-0379, D-0389, D-0393, D-0395 and D-0399. The factory takes Kind: plumbing issues on another GitHub repository once a valid .invariant/repository.json and a capable invariant/gate are committed on its authoritative base; configuration only on an issue branch, in a checkout or in a builder workspace doesn't count. Without them it still answers that plumbing isn't set up there and how to set it up, labels the issue for a person and drafts nothing, on revisions and repeated polls too. Each proposal captures one committed snapshot and carries it in request-local context through planning, the real builder, fallback, repairs, review, scope and publication; revisions and restarts recover it from the plan's execution base. Ratification, building, readiness and the final checked-head merge check the plan against the captured and current base contract and every retained gate, with its Invariant commit pin: changed or missing authority holds the recorded work for a person until it's restored and a writer comments /invariant retry, which resumes publication without rebuilding. D-0121's reasons no longer hold: the gate runs the repository's own checks, scope and ratification (D-0395, D-0399), agents get the repository's own context (D-0389), trust follows its contract (D-0379), and the sandbox prepares its locked dependencies (D-0305). The merger hand-fixed native authority recovery so an upgraded gate can't wedge /invariant solve, and ran the real dependency preparation, the pinned-image configured Go check and the four-framework builder matrix on #762's head.
